objectives: Create, list, complete and delete todos over HTTP
features: GET /todos lists every todo in creation order
PATCH /todos/:id with {"done":true} marks a todo done

acceptanceCriteria.when: POST /todos is called with {"title":"Buy milk"}, then without a title
acceptanceCriteria.then: the first call answers 201 with the new todo (string id, title "Buy milk", done false); the second answers 400 and {"error":"title is required"}
status 200 and an array with both todos in creation order
status 200 and the todo with done true; an unknown id answers 404 and {"error":"not found"}
status 204 and the todo no longer appears in GET /todos; an unknown id answers 404 and {"error":"not found"}
